events.name: Mail-ballot SCOTUS emergency: states/voting-rights groups' response deadline (Justice Jackson's order)
events.reason: CORRECTED 2026-09-08: this outlet previously carried a 10 AM Tuesday Sept 8 deadline forward from the withdrawn application; that date did not carry over. DOJ withdrew its original Sept 3 application and filed a new application (now docketed 26A305, not 26A297) seeking a stay of Judge Talwani's Sept 4 preliminary injunction against the USPS mail-ballot rule specifically. Justice Jackson set the response deadline at 4:00 PM EDT Wednesday Sept 9. North Carolina continues mailing absentee ballots under separate, related litigation. Logged to ledgers/corrections.json.
events.source: Supreme Court docket 26A305 (primary); SCOTUSblog, Axios, NBC News, PBS NewsHour -- Confirmed-multiple

events.name: Rep. McIver's en banc petition window closes (approx.), Third Circuit
events.reason: CORRECTED 2026-09-08: this system's prior ~Sept 9 estimate used a 14-day window; the standard FRAP deadline for a rehearing/en banc petition when the US is a party is 45 days from the Third Circuit panel's Aug 26 ruling, which points to roughly Oct 10, not Sept 9. No filing confirmed as of this cycle. Date remains approximate, not a court-set deadline this system has directly verified. Not printed as a formal correction in a report since the earlier Sept 9 date was never published in report text, only held internally.
events.source: Roll Call, The Hill -- Confirmed-multiple on the underlying ruling; filing status unconfirmed
